modules.title: Content-Addressed Build
modules.summary: Canonical outputs bind the catalog and retrieval index to one deterministic corpus root.

modules.title: Citation Verification
modules.summary: Every cited span carries a path, line range, artifact digest, and span digest that can be checked later.

modules.title: Explainable Retrieval
modules.summary: Deterministic ranking reports BM25, heading, and exact-phrase components alongside each result.

modules.title: Publication Boundary
modules.summary: The candidate tree must satisfy path, metadata, content, and exact-manifest contracts before publication.

pipeline: Build the catalog, index, and attestation

qc_checks.name: Reference integrity
qc_checks.description: Every record supplies a coded ID, canonical type, and canonical date.

qc_checks.name: Citation integrity
qc_checks.description: Artifact and selected-span digests must match the addressed source lines.

qc_checks.name: Bundle reproducibility
qc_checks.description: Independent builds from the same sources must be byte-identical.

qc_checks.name: Publication parity
qc_checks.description: Tracked and non-ignored candidates must match the reviewed tree manifest.

readiness_lanes.name: Compile lane
readiness_lanes.description: Strict inputs become line-addressed evidence chunks.

readiness_lanes.name: Retrieve lane
readiness_lanes.description: Ranked results carry explanations and citations together.

readiness_lanes.name: Verify lane
readiness_lanes.description: Sources, spans, and generated outputs are checked for drift.

readiness_lanes.name: Publish lane
readiness_lanes.description: The candidate tree must match its reviewed manifest.
